speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The children have their shoes. I will go on ahead with them and keep them out of the kennel.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go on. The shop door is shut.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Leave the shop door as it stands, Will. Thy father has his own morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Come, Mother. Take my arm. It is two years since I walked you this way.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: It is two years since I had it. Mind the step at the sill.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: We will be at the church door before you. Susanna has Judith's cuff.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two years. You have the arm.
